without a second read model.

1. SHARE THE PURE DERIVATIONS AT THE SERVICE BOUNDARY. Move the pure presentation
   derivations out of apps/control_room/routes/glance.py into a service-owned module
   (apps/control_room/services/run_evidence.py, or services/operations.py):
   _resolve_recorded_path/_recorded_ledger (the "/repo/..." path must resolve to the
   checkout on the host), _cost_provenance, _measured_state, _receipt_state,
   _narration_state, _attempt_number, _workspace_target, _cell_binding. glance.py
   imports them (no duplicate implementations remain); operations.run_detail uses
   the same functions. Route -> service is the correct dependency direction.

2. EXTEND run_detail ADDITIVELY. Keep the existing six top-level keys and the raw
   run/attempt/gate/approval/command blocks compatible. Add derived blocks:
   - cost: {provenance: "<label>"} — measured zero = "$0.0000 · metered"; absent =
     unknown; mixed contributors = mixed.
   - evidence: {measured, receipt, narration} — the same labels glance emits.
   - recorded: {ledger_path, present} — the pointer and whether it resolved.
   - delivered_knowledge: per phase, from the recorded ledger: selected_evidence_ids,
     augmentation_evidence [{id, revision, source_type, locator}], fallback_mode,
     retrieval_leg_errors, augmentation_versions/tokens/cost. Selection/delivery only
     — do NOT claim use. Missing ledger/key = named absence, never fabricated.
   - prepared: per phase, when recorded (see 3): the prepared step clone-relative
     path + prompt_sha256; otherwise a named missing.
   - timings: one row per timing field ACTUALLY recorded (declare the exact set from
     the run/attempt records + ledger; do not invent queue wait or first-token values
     that are not recorded): {field, value, state: measured|unknown}.

3. RECORD THE PREPARED-STEP REFERENCE through existing owners (no new transport, no
   broker/compose change): when the orchestrator parent prepares a child step, record
   the prepared step's clone-relative path + prompt_sha256 on the phase result and the
   run ledger (copy through DockerAgentExecutor's StepResult into the PhaseResult; if
   the child envelope already carries it, reuse that field). Extend tests.

4. RENDER IT IN THE LOADED DRAWER (app.js renderRunDetail). Show: cost provenance
   (fall back to "unavailable" — never a fabricated value); a Verification section
   with the independent verification separate from the agent's own claim (SAID vs
   MEASURED); a Delivered knowledge section (ids, revisions/locators, fallback mode,
   leg errors, "selected — use not established"); the prepared-step reference or its
   named gap; Timings rows with data-state="measured|unknown". Keep the existing
   identity/attempts/gates/approvals/commands tables and the existing error handling.
   Do not touch parity.js. No new endpoints. No client-side derivation of
   consequential values.

5. FIXTURE + GATE. Update the run_detail seed in
   apps/control_room/verification/fixtures/boards_endpoints.json to the real payload
   shape (the current seed uses fields the real record does not have) plus the new
   blocks. Extend scripts/verify_control_room_rendering.py (restored-board classes)
   with drawer-content assertions: cost provenance including a measured-zero and an
   unknown case, one measured verification with independence, delivered-knowledge
   ids, one [data-state="unknown"] timing, and a run-detail HTTP-200 error-envelope
   case. Keep --check-fixtures green.

6. TESTS. Extend tests/test_control_room_operations.py (block keys, the 200 envelope

   ledger), tests/test_control_room_glance_integrity.py (import path change; keep

   tests/test_control_room_feature_parity.py (drawer anchors),
   tests/test_admin_frontend.py, and the prepared-step/workflow-runner tests you
   touch. Run the verification commands in context.verification. Commit.

## Pinned requirements — run-evidence slice (2026-09-19)

TRUTHFULNESS: a measured zero stays a measured zero ("$0.0000 · metered"); a missing
cost stays unknown (never $0.0000, never a fabricated amount); mixed contributors stay
mixed. An unobserved timing or verification carries a named unknown, never a 0. The
independent verification is shown separately from the agent's own claim — a process or
agent claim is not independent acceptance.

DELIVERY vs USE: show WHICH records were selected and WHAT was delivered into the
prepared prompt (ids, revisions, locators, fallback mode, leg errors); an id proves
neither relevance nor use — use is a separate, later judgement and is NOT claimed.

SCOPE: the served page (index.html + app.js) is the journey; the parked parity.js
workbench is NOT the target. No second read model or live-state authority; no
business rules in JavaScript; no new endpoints; preserve the raw
run/attempt/gate/approval/command blocks and existing callers; preserve every existing
test that does not encode the old defect. Missing instrumentation is a named gap, not
a frontend estimation task. Do not expose private coordinator history or raw
unrestricted prompts through the UI.

LAYOUT: keep the seven-board recovery direction; do not copy the superseded
R0/R1/workbench selector requirements; preserve historical run artifacts; report
coverage truthfully (an omitted check is not a pass).
